full_name: Laura DeMarco | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Mathematics Radcliffe Alumnae Professor Harvard University
bio: Laura DeMarco is a professor of mathematics at Harvard University and a member of the National Academy of Sciences. While at Radcliffe, she will work on the theory of algebraic dynamical systems, exploring complexity in iterative processes and the ways that arithmetic (that is, number theory) governs the geometric features of a system.
